title: Narrow delivered source-observation finalization projection to avoid queue-change stalls
outcome: Narrow delivered source-observation finalization projection to avoid queue-change stalls
acceptance: Delivered observation finalization acknowledges only its relevant handoff and owner state; a concurrent benign queue-head change cannot make its persistence fence wait until the full dispatch deadline.
A deterministic production-path control changes the queue between finalization publication and the SQLite write and verifies prompt completion proceeds while exact cleanup proof remains required.
